name: fluxone
description: FluxOne offline-first POS — client, server, Electron

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run electron:dev"
scripts.electron:dist: npm run build --prefix client && npm run dist --prefix electron
scripts.electron:pack: npm run build --prefix client && npm run pack --prefix electron
scripts.build:staging: npm run build:client && cross-env NODE_ENV=staging npm run dist --prefix electron
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:client && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run dist --prefix electron
scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix electron && npm install && npm run setup --prefix server
